description: This file contains unit tests for the OrderTotal functionality within the Order aggregate in the application's core entities. It verifies that the total calculation in an order is correct for various scenarios with different item counts.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: Unit test class for validating the correctness of order total calculations.

methods.name: IsZeroForNewOrder
methods.description: Tests that a newly created order with no items has a total of zero.

methods.name: IsCorrectGiven1Item
methods.description: Verifies that the total matches the single item's unit price.

methods.name: IsCorrectGiven3Items
methods.description: Checks that the total equals the product of unit price and quantity for default items.
